# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 70 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 70

**1** Jesus said: "If you bring forth what is within you, what you bring forth will save you. If you do not bring forth what is within you, what you do not bring forth will destroy you."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- Consistent repetition of "bring forth" throughout — the verb is the key action
- "Destroy you" over "kill you" — the spiritual register of destruction rather than physical killing
- The parallel structure (if/if not) is made perfectly symmetrical
